policy_cards.title: Required audit records must be preserved
policy_cards.requirement: Required audit records must be preserved when deleting or deactivating a user.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Compliance and incident response require retained audit history.
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: Deleting a user can erase required audit evidence.
audit_questions: Does deletion preserve required audit records?
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: User deletion must preserve existing audit log entries.
policy_cards.example_failure: User is deleted and audit_log becomes empty.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: Existing audit entries remain after deletion.
policy_cards.requirement_test: Required audit records must be preserved

policy_cards.title: Deletion metadata must be recorded
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: There is no record of who deleted the user.
audit_questions: Does deletion append metadata including actor and target?
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Deletion must append an audit event with actor_id and target user_id.
policy_cards.example_failure: User deleted but no user_deleted event exists.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: Audit log includes user_deleted event with actor_id.
